title: Products
subtitle_empty: Your store's offers, as they reach Google
cost_explainer: Add the cost price so Hontrio knows each product's margin and never spends more on ads than the sale brings in.
cost_hint_vat: Your store prices include VAT, so enter the cost with VAT included too.
cost_hint_no_vat: Your store prices exclude VAT, so enter the cost without VAT too.
cost_hint_unknown: Your store prices are what customers pay (no VAT is added at checkout), so enter the cost including VAT, as you pay the supplier.
search_placeholder: Search by name, variant, SKU or GTIN
google_none_hint: This offer was not sent to Merchant Center from Edinio.
apply_variants_hint: Set the {{cost}} cost on every variant of this product
load_error: We could not load your products.
no_store_title: Connect your store to see your products
no_store_desc: Hontrio reads your catalog and sales so it knows which products are worth promoting.
unsupported_title: This store's platform isn't on the new model yet
unsupported_desc: Products come from Edinio, WooCommerce and Shopify for now; other platforms are coming.
revoked: Access to the {{platform}} store was stopped, so products are no longer updated.
first_sync_desc: We are bringing in your catalog and orders. It can take a few minutes.
empty_desc: Your store has no active products that can reach Google.
store_error: The {{platform}} store did not respond at the last sync. We try again at every sync.
sync_partial: So far we brought in {{offers}} and {{orders}}. The store is large: the rest comes with the next syncs, in the background.
cost_estimated_hint: Filled in bulk, as a percentage of the price. Enter the real cost when you know it.
cost_from_platform_hint: Taken from {{platform}} at every sync. If you change it here, the cost you entered is kept.
cost_cogs_hint_woocommerce: If you keep costs in WooCommerce (the "Cost of Goods Sold" feature, under Settings → Advanced → Features), Hontrio picks them up at every sync.
bulk_title: Cost as a percentage of price
bulk_hint: If you roughly know what your goods cost, say 60% of the selling price, fill in the costs in one go, for the whole catalog, a category or a brand. We mark them "estimated" and you can correct them one by one at any time.
bulk_only_missing: Only products without a cost price
bulk_overwrite_warning: Careful: this also replaces costs you entered, on {{count}} of them.
bulk_nothing: Nothing to fill in here: every offer already has a cost price.
bulk_error: We couldn't fill in the costs. Please try again.
bulk_done: Costs filled in: {{count}}. They are marked "estimated": correct them when you know the real cost.
cost_from_platform_hint_vat: Taken from {{platform}} at every sync. There it is the accounting cost, without VAT; here VAT is added so it compares with the price. If you change it here, the cost you entered is kept.
cost_cogs_hint_shopify: If you keep costs in Shopify ("Cost per item" on each product), Hontrio picks them up at every sync.
